title: Advisory
description: One normalized advisory (an alias cluster). Ingest writes it to data/advisories/<id>.json; the same object appears in every products/<slug>.json it affects.

id.description: Cluster id: the CVE id when one exists, else the GHSA id, else the vendor id.

aliases.description: Every other id in the cluster (GHSA, USN, DSA, vendor ids). Never contains id itself.

summary.description: Plain text from the source record. Consumers must escape it.

score.description: CVSS base score, or null when there is none.

source.description: Which record the score came from, in the fallback order cna, ghsa, nvd, vendor; none when level is unknown.

kev.description: Listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. listed is only a real no when checked is true: without checked (or with checked false) the catalog was not read for this advisory, so consumers must say not checked, never not listed.

checked.description: True when the advisory's CVE ids were looked up in the KEV catalog. Missing or false means not checked. Ingest always writes it.

epss.description: FIRST EPSS exploit probability, or null when unknown.

corrections.description: Products whose ranges Advisorydeck corrected by hand because the upstream record is wrong (a typo that makes current releases read affected). The ranges in affected are already the corrected ones; show the reason and the evidence next to them. Absent when nothing was corrected.

sources.description: The records this advisory was built from, for attribution.

license.description: License or terms the record is used under, for example CVE-TOU or CC-BY-4.0.

revision.description: Opaque material revision. It changes only on a material change (severity level, ranges, KEV, EPSS threshold, reviewed note); consumers renotify when it changes.

note.description: The reviewed curated note, or null. Drafts and disputed notes are never published here.

ranges.description: Affected version ranges in the product's version scheme. An empty list means the affected versions are unknown: consumers must say check manually, never not affected.

range.title: VersionRange
range.description: introduced is inclusive (0 means from the first version); fixed is exclusive; last_affected is inclusive. At most one of fixed and last_affected; neither means no fix yet.
